prompt: Two villages, one of fishermen on the coast and one of shepherds inland, joined by a road.

card.name: Fishermen and Shepherds

site.text: Two villages joined by a road: a fishing village on the coast and a shepherds' village inland, linked by a road running between them.

style.text: Humble, weathered working villages: timber, thatch, stone, wool and nets, with a rustic pastoral coastal feel.

purpose.text: A fishing village on the coast and a shepherding village inland, each making a living from its own trade and connected by a road.

card.interpretation: You asked for two small villages: fishermen on the coast and shepherds inland, joined by a road. I treated this as one village-style settlement in two clusters, with existing coast and grassland used where possible, a rustic look, and a mix of homes and trade buildings in each cluster plus an inn halfway along the road.
assumptions: Size L, since there are two villages and a road within the 64-block claim radius.
Rustic style chosen because none was given.
Terrain: find a coast and inland pasture; no sculpting.
Added a wayside inn on the road as a link between the villages.
Search for a spot, since no location was named.

program.notes: Coastal village hub with a lantern-lit pier view; where catches are tallied and the fishermen gather.
Coastal village; small timber homes with nets, barrels and drying racks outside.
Coastal village; boats and gear stored at the water's edge with a short jetty.
Coastal village; smoked and salted fish sold from stalls.
Inland village; low thatched homes with small pens beside them.
Inland village; fenced fold and barn for shearing and wool storage.
Inland village; looms and wool dyed in bright colours.
Inland village; shepherds watch the flocks from here.
Midway along the road between the two villages; a resting place for travellers carrying fish and wool.
